Author: @EtrnayDad
Content: When I was about 14-15, My little sister and I met some guy from the UK online- through Omegle. We talked for a little through the chat system, and eventually we added each other on Skype. It wasn't uncommon for me to have online friends, I was that shut in gamer type and even had an online friend group, some of us are still good friends today. But something was off about this guy, at first I couldn't tell what it was, I just thought he was a sad and lonely man. Which he was, I could tell he was not confident in many aspects of himself, he seemed ashamed of how he was. As we got to know each other more, I thought it was going to be a friendship- a brag to people I knew like 'I have friends overseas, I get to witness all these cool cultures'. Then he turned the situation upside down, in this one line I knew what was in store for me. "Are you alone". In context for a video chat, that is still creepy as fuck. I asked why, and he said in more colorful words, he wanted to show himself to me. I told him it was illegal, that the age of consent is different in my country than his- he did not care. I blocked him from Skype, and never talked to him again. Thankfully my sister lost interest in the guy from day1. I told her and my online friends about what happened, and even if we're not friends today, I'm grateful my bois helped protect me and her from future creeps weaseling their way in and ruining the rest of our precious childhood memories.
